caption: Canouan Housing Development
description: Blue three-story apartment in foreground, green three-story apartment in background. Both enclosed by fences.

caption: Coral Reef Preschool
description: Single-story, pale pink building with green trim behind a small sign declaring the building's name.

caption: Preschool and Primary school
description: Mostly obsured, the pink building sits in the foreground behind a white picket fence. A lilac multi-part, one-story building is in the background near an open field.

caption: Coral Reef Preschool Semi-Interior
description: Three white doors open to a veranda with green beams and a pink wall. There is a bright red picnic bench before of the wall.

caption: Coral Reef Preschool Interior
description: White room with five doors opening onto the verand allowing light in. Colourful pre-school furniture arranged neatly. Ceiling is high with white beams.

caption: Canouan Primary School
description: Lilac, three-part, one-story building at the top and to the right of an open field. Pink building further away to the left and a green mountain behind the buildings.

caption: Villa Ferrari
description: Cluster of white buildings surrounded by a forest and overlooking the sea.

caption: Villa Ferrari Gate
description: White wall with a dark brown wooden door Hanging square lamps on either side of the door. A palm branch hangs in the foreground.

caption: Villa Ferrari Semi-Interior
description: Dark brown wooden awning canopy leads from the foreground to the pool.

caption: Villa Ferrari Interior
description: White room with dark brown wooden accents and furniture. The four sofas are white, paired facing each other.

caption: Canouan Housing Development Staff Quarters
description: Lilac two-story apartment with picket railing overlooking the sea.

caption: Fire-Fighting Station
description: Small dark brown building with green slanted roof. A white truck shown is shown in the open left garage door.
